basis: Benign vascular neoplasm arising in the liver; vascular histology alone does not establish cardiovascular organ damage or endocrine disease.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: a localized hepatic hemangioma does not establish a separate cardiovascular organ disorder.

basis: Congenital absence of enteric ganglia defines the disease, directly affecting peripheral nervous tissue and intestinal motility.

decisions.neurologic: primary: enteric ganglia belong to the peripheral nervous system; their complete absence is the defining lesion.

basis: Cowden mucocutaneous hamartomas, including oral papillomas, and intestinal hamartomas are defining features. Thyroid carcinoma in 6/7 remains a separate associated cancer.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: oral papillomatosis and gastrointestinal hamartomas are defining Cowden manifestations; oral mucosa belongs to this axis.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: thyroid carcinoma in 6/7 is a separately diagnosed associated cancer; goiter and thyroiditis lack frequencies establishing common intrinsic involvement.

basis: Defining intellectual disability, ectodermal defects and urethral hypospadias occur in 80-99%; skeletal involvement includes clinodactyly in 80-99% and syndactyly in 30-79%.

decisions.renal: primary: hypospadias is a defining urethral malformation, reported in 80-99%; the renal axis explicitly includes the urethra.

basis: Immune-mediated inflammatory keratinization disorder affecting skin, hair and nails; no common damaging extracutaneous involvement established.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: PRP is an immune-mediated inflammatory dermatosis, although its initiating cause and mechanisms vary across subtypes.

basis: GPI-anchor defect with ID and defining phalangeal hypoplasia (3/3); anorectal defects in at least 2/3. Nail hypoplasia (3/3), cardiac/urinary defects (1/3) omitted by cap.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: distal phalangeal hypoplasia and broad halluces occur in 3/3; brachytelephalangy is a defining feature of this syndrome.

basis: CNS hypomyelination defines PMD. Visual impairment in 80-99% can be central; optic atrophy in one assessed patient does not establish common ocular damage.

decisions.ocular: none: frequent visual impairment does not distinguish central dysfunction from ocular injury; optic atrophy in 1/1 does not establish its usual frequency.

basis: Defining vascular/skin lesions and thrombocytopenia; GI lesions/bleeding 80-99%. Lung lesions and intracranial bleeding 30-79% omitted by cap. MALT1 definition is mismapped.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: congenital multifocal cutaneous vascular lesions define this cutaneovisceral syndrome; skin abnormalities occur in 80-99%.

basis: Ovarian endocrine hyperstimulation and capillary leak define OHSS; pleural effusions occupy the pleural space in 30-79%. Renal failure and pulmonary edema are minority complications.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: pleural effusion occurs in 30-79% and directly occupies the pleural space, impairing lung expansion; this exceeds a transient nonspecific sign.

basis: Riboflavin transport defect with defining neuropathy and sensorineural deafness. Muscle wasting is neurogenic; optic atrophy and skeletal deformities occur in 5-29%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: weakness and amyotrophy reflect denervation rather than direct skeletal muscle disease; kyphoscoliosis and scoliosis are only 5-29%.
